common: Flat-colored anime background painting style for a cel-shaded game: flat matte colors, thin warm-black ink lines, subtle paper grain, muted low-saturation palette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks.

items.name: T_Products
items.prompt: A straight-on flat front view filling the whole image edge to edge of densely packed convenience store shelf facings in 4 horizontal rows with no shelf edges visible: row 1 colorful snack bags, row 2 cup ramen and instant noodle bowls, row 3 boxed cookies and bread, row 4 soft drink bottles, milk cartons and water bottles. Every package is a simple block of flat color with a plain darker band or circle, absolutely no readable writing. No alcohol, no cigarettes.

items.name: T_FortressView
items.prompt: A wide flat background view as seen through a window on a bright spring morning: the old Seoul fortress wall of large grey granite blocks running along a green hill with pine trees and a few blossoming trees, a low traditional pavilion roof far away on the ridge, pale cream sky. Painted as a flat anime background, no frame, no people.

items.name: T_Wallpaper
items.prompt: A seamless tileable pattern of old faded Korean apartment wallpaper filling the whole image: cream background #E7DCC4 with small scattered pale brown and dusty pink floral sprigs in a regular half-drop repeat, very low contrast, flat colors, no shading, no border.
